turns.learner: Hi! Can we learn he, she and it with -s today?
turns.tutor:
Yes! Example: My mother cooks dinner.
Rule: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: He reads the news. Wrong: He read the news.
Your turn. Write only the verb: My brother ___ (walk) to work.
